art_direction: A plain painted interior wall finish matching the source room’s deep muted forest-green/blue-green color. Use restrained fine roller stipple and broad, low-amplitude tonal variation with matte eggshell response. Keep window and door openings, casing, baseboards, crown, wall art, and cutaway geometry separate.
intended_function: Provide a photo-specific wall-paint material on existing wall segments in room_photo_luna. The ArtBrief sample is evidence only; RoomDefinition controls every runtime segment, opening, and cutaway.

citizen_scale.ratio_or_view: The production room uses the exact 0.5-inch citizen height; this material does not redefine scale.

construction_materials.material: deep muted forest green/teal eggshell paint
construction_materials.construction: plain wall with subtle fine roller stipple; product and exact sheen are uncertain

source_photo_constraints: Sample (1) shows plain deep green/teal painted walls, separate stained-wood trim, and visible windows. The broad hue and plain-wall construction are evidenced. Exact paint formula and sheen are uncertain because the room is photographed in mixed daylight and shadow. Wall art and fixtures are separate objects; do not turn them into painted wall geometry.
silhouette_requirements: plain continuous wall planes around existing openings
consistent color and matte response across wall segments
baseboards, crown, casing, wall art, doors, windows, and cutaway remain separate
prohibited_failure_modes: do not alter wall positions, height, thickness, openings, collision, navigation, or cutaway behavior
do not invent paneling, wainscoting, wallpaper, built-ins, or decorative joints
do not merge or recolor separate wood trim, casing, windows, doors, or wall art
do not create a visible repeated square patch pattern
gameplay_distance_readability: Keep the deep green wall field calm at 64, 160, and 330 inches; show only subtle paint stipple at the 12-inch close view.
roomdefinition_authority: RoomDefinition rooms/room_photo_luna.json remains authoritative for all wall segments, openings, height, thickness, collision, navigation, and cutaway behavior.
